facts: Parties: Corrib Energy plc (Company) and Ivybridge Bioscience Securities (Underwriter).
Clause 4: the Company grants the Underwriters an option to purchase up to 2,000,000 additional shares (the Over-allotment Option), representing 15% of the 10,000,000 Firm Shares.
Clause 3: the Company shall pay the Underwriters a commission of 7.0% of the gross proceeds of the Offering (10,000,000 shares at $14.00 per share), being $8,330,000.
Issuer: Corrib Energy plc. The date of this Prospectus is 31 July 2026.
Legal Proceedings: the Company is not party to any legal proceedings which may have a significant effect on its financial position.
Item 3: the board discussed a class action filed by Redcliffe Software Ltd seeking $12,500,000 in damages. Counsel assesses the claim as having reasonable prospects.
